expectations.text: The reply reports the uncaught JSON parse error (SyntaxError) captured from the page console or page errors after the click
expectations.evidence: The agent says it clicked the button in headless Chromium while watching the console, and reports "Error on click: `Expected ',' or '}' after property value in JSON at position 12 (line 1 column 13)`" and that "`JSON.parse` throws a `SyntaxError`".

expectations.text: The reply names the malformed JSON literal (missing closing brace) as the cause
expectations.evidence: The reply says "`'{"total": 12'` has no closing `}`, so `JSON.parse` throws" and suggests the fix `JSON.parse('{"total": 12}')`.
